tagline: Every funeral director in South West England, with sourced details and independent annual awards.

publisher.name: Sean Munn
publisher.bio: Sean Munn is the editor of Funeral Director Awards. He runs Next Chapter Media, a UK marketing agency that helps independent funeral directors get found by the families searching for them. He started this directory to give families clear, sourced information about every funeral director in South West England, and to recognise the firms doing the job well. Every listing is built from public data and each firm's own website, and every correction is checked by hand.

faq.q: How are funeral directors listed here?
faq.a: Every listing starts from Google Maps data for funeral directors in South West England. We keep firms that are open and have reviews, merge duplicates, and read each firm's own website for its details. Owners can claim a listing for free to correct it or add photos.

faq.q: Do funeral directors pay to be listed or to rank higher?
faq.a: No. Listing is free, claiming is free and entering the awards is free. Nothing on this site is for sale, and the order on every page follows the published method on our How we score page.

It is published by Next Chapter Media, a trading name of AI Video Systems, a marketing agency that works with funeral directors. Some listed firms are its clients; they are scored and judged exactly like everyone else.

disclosure: Funeral Director Awards is published by Next Chapter Media, a trading name of AI Video Systems. Next Chapter Media is a marketing agency that works with funeral directors, and some of the firms listed here are its clients. Listing, claiming and entering the awards are free. Clients are ordered and judged by exactly the same published method as every other firm, our independent judges are never told who is a client, and no business can pay to change its position or its chances of winning.
